verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents card issuing at scale and authorization controls that set rules on how and where issued cards may be used, plus marketed spend controls. Together these support creating cards scoped to a purpose. The evidence never explicitly says the cards are virtual, that they can be created instantly, or that they can be locked to a single merchant or category such as ad spend. Missing for 10: explicit virtual card issuance, evidence of instant creation, documented merchant- or category-level scoping examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
